The password file is being rejected by the new box's sudo. I'll test whether it's the password for the old box instead.I can't use sudo yet: the password in `~/.metameso` doesn't work on either box.

- **New box:** sudo rejected it, first when piped in and again when typed at a proper terminal prompt. The file itself is fine: one line, 32 characters, no stray spaces or line endings. So it's a different password from the one the new box has for joe.
- **Old box:** rejected there too, so it isn't the password you set with `passwd joe` in Lish tonight either.

I stopped after four attempts, so repeated failures don't lock the account. The file was group-readable, so I've made it readable only by you.

The new box's joe account was created with the same password hash as on the old box. Your `passwd joe` in Lish tonight changed the old box only, so the new box still expects joe's **old** metameso password, the one in the SSD creds. If you're not sure which one it is, you can reset it: in Lish, switch to the new box (`metameso-2026`), log in as root, run `passwd joe`, and put the new password in `~/.metameso`.

The Lish key is back in place, thanks. Once sudo works, I'll run the final sync and remove `preswap.conf`. Then I'll stop before the IP swap, which needs either you on linode.com or a Linode API token.
